current_state: Phase 09 is planned but implementation has not started. The plan defines a bounded ANP compatibility spike: public-safe ANP Agent Description JSON-LD and .well-known/agent-descriptions discovery, without replacing OpenHub ACN auth, scoped keys, task routing, evidence bundles, or review gates.
human_actions_pending: None for planning. Release/tag creation still requires explicit operator version/target approval later.

decisions.decision: Treat ANP as an interoperability/discovery compatibility layer, not an auth/control-plane replacement.
decisions.rationale: OpenHub's current value depends on scoped keys, invite-based onboarding, task routing, evidence, and review gates. ANP discovery can help external agents find public OpenHub agents without weakening those controls.

decisions.decision: Default ANP public discovery to opt-in only.
decisions.rationale: The public endpoints must not leak private agents or raw metadata. Agents appear only when explicitly marked public via labels or metadata.
ANP's DID layer is deeper than this spike. The route should include DID only if an agent explicitly supplies one.

resume_instructions: Start with 09-01: create docs/ANP_COMPATIBILITY.md and 09-01 evidence.
Use TDD for 09-02 through 09-04 exactly as listed in the plan.
Run focused tests, dependency drift, GSD health/consistency, git diff --check, and secret/no-leak scans before each commit.
Commit and push each completed slice; verify HEAD = origin/master = remote/master before reporting done.

required_gates: focused pytest for changed backend routes/services
